exposure: residual myometrial thickness at the scar site
grading of nourishing blood supply to the gestational sac
risk group (low-risk vs. high-risk based on score)
outcome: selection of surgical methods for cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSEP)
agreement between predicted and actual treatment protocols
cohort: The study included 117 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSEP).
finding: The ultrasound quantitative scoring system showed consistency (kappa = 0.644) between predicted and actual treatment methods, providing clinically valuable individualized assessment for CSEP patients, particularly those in the low-risk group.
